name: QUAL-SUNCAM gcov dump — development-only coverage dump of the instrumented SunCamRef (fth dev-campaign, harness skill §3a)
deployment: SunCamRef (fprime-community/fprime-devices-reference), Linux aarch64 on the Pi 5 bench host, KissCAM V2 on /dev/ttyUSB0 (FTDI USB-RS422 FTAQMGVF), fprime-gds over TCP on the Pi

image_version.reason: SunCamRef includes Svc.Version; L0-1 compares the FrameworkVersion/ProjectVersion/LibraryVersions payloads with the manifest describe strings (helper version_matches_manifest)

l0: L0: marker format as the main plan; CovDump event formats are the fth coverage-system contract (fth/system_coverage.py)

not_covered_ack: REQ-004/016/018 timeout and failed-step paths: the bench camera answers and cannot be silenced (no power control); unit tests cover them

REQ-020 stray/malformed/late frames and the power-on line (SDD §Hardware notes, Power-on line; 21 unframed bytes): no second writer on the bus and a camera power cycle is performed only by the human on request; unit tests cover them (testMalformedAndStrayFrames, testPowerOnBanner)
REQ-021 mode mismatch while READY: needs a camera power-cycle; unit test
REQ-024 UART send failure and product allocation failure: not plantable without breaking the deployment; unit tests
REQ-028 exposure readback mismatch: the camera reads back what it stores; unit test
REQ-029 queue-full hooks: unreachable at 10 Hz / 115200 baud without a flood tool; unit tests
REQ-030 exact tick period: unit test; the quiet windows L0-1/L0-2 prove the periodic write on hardware
REQ-011 camera-refused push: not reachable now that EXPOSURE is range-checked locally; unit tests

HD FULL download: four slots of the SD FULL shape (L2-5), the bench exercises the HD PREVIEW four-quadrant product (L2-10); ZOOM not run on the bench; Memory Status and camera-side parameter errors are not available on this hardware (SDD §Hardware notes); rejected HD slot (REQ-035) unit-tested only
coverage.rationale: UT baseline 95: the host build forces every error branch; on-target 75: camera-side faults (timeout, 0xFF on most commands, send failure) cannot be forced without power control or a fault injector.

scope: - Dump plan run right after the main plan on the SAME gcov-instrumented image (fth flashes the same image; the hosted libgcov wrote the .gcda of every process life at exit, DUMP_COVERAGE merges the live counters and streams the files).
- Not an RfR plan: its record is the input of `fth coverage-system`; the RfR verdicts come from the uninstrumented image.

GC-DUMP.note: The instrumented SunCamRef image streams its gcda bytes completely and consistently (CoverageDumpDone count/bytes/crc agree with the chunks) so fth coverage-system can place them beside the .gcno of the pinned build (harness skill §3a). Development evidence only.

tests.title: gcov dump of the instrumented image
tests.purpose: Stream every .gcda of KissCam.SunCamMgr to the record for fth coverage-system
tests.setup: Instrumented SunCamRef (-DSUNCAMREF_COVERAGE=ON) flashed by the bench flash script after the main plan ran on the same image; GDS attached.
